actions.name: Talons

bonusActions.name: Spring Attack
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The achaierai takes the Disengage action.

reactions.name: Defensive Cloud
reactions.descriptionHtml: After taking damage the achaierai can use its reaction to release a cloud of poisonous gas in a 10-foot-radius. All creatures in the cloud take 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned the target is confused as if from a confusion spell. At the end of its turns, the affected target can repeat the Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds the confusion ends. Achaierai are immune to the effects of this cloud.

2e.name: Searing Smite
2e.castingTime: 1 bonus action (which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike)

traits.name: Infernal Tracker
traits.descriptionHtml: Aribeth knows the distance to and direction of any creature that has broken a pact with Mephistopheles, even if the creature and Aribeth are on different planes of existence.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Aribeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Nightmare
traits.descriptionHtml: Aribeth is accompanied by a nightmare. The nightmare allows Aribeth to use it as a mount.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: Aribeth regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If Aribeth takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Aribeth's next turn. Aribeth's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Shadows
traits.descriptionHtml: Three shadow hide within the saddle of Aribeth's nightmare. These shadows only come out if there is a creature within 30 feet that is at 0 hit points. When that happens, a shadow emerges and attacks the creature in order to make it fail a death saving throw. It continues to do so until the creature is dead.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.descriptionHtml: While in sunlight, Aribeth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Aribeth makes three Void or Unholy Strike attacks.

actions.name: Void
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the sword Void dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

actions.name: Unholy Strike
actions.descriptionHtml: rs +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.descriptionHtml: Aribeth adds 4 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Aribeth must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

1e.name: Symbol

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Lord of Flies
traits.descriptionHtml: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Stench of the Slug
traits.descriptionHtml: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul uses Heart of Pestilence (if available), then makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pungent Eruption (Recharge 4)
actions.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul causes refuse and caustic liquid to spill from the ground at a point he can see within 300 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 36 (8d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a greater restoration spell or similar is cast.

bonusActions.name: Displace
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Pummel
entries.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul uses Displace.

entries.name: Insect Gorge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute, or until Baalzebul uses this ability again. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

entries.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

name: Bebilith
languages: understands Abyssal but only speaks telepathically to its own kind

traits.name: Dark Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede the bebilith's darkvision.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down, without needing to make an ability check and ignores any movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The bebilith uses Poisoned Web (if available) and then makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage. Any creature that drops to zero hit points because of this attack ignites, suffering 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the creature's hit points are above zero.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 (4d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Web (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +10 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. {@h}51 (10d8 + 6) poison damage, and the target has the restrained condition until free of the web. While restrained, the target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target may use an action to make a DC 17 Strength check and if successful they are freed from the webbing. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage). If an attack or spell doing fire damage is used on the webbing, the webbing ignites (but is otherwise unharmed). Any creature restrained by the webbing suffers an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turn.

actions.name: Stalker's Darkness (3/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The bebilith casts darkness.

bonusActions.name: Relentless Hunter
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The bebilith may use a bonus action to mark prey that it has damaged. Only one creature can be marked at a time. The bebilith always knows the exact location of the marked prey on the current plane of existence, can't be surprised by it, and has advantage on all attack rolls against it.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Avatar of Bhaal
traits.descriptionHtml: When the ravager drops to 0 hit points, its form fractures. Within the next 24 hours, it will reappear in its Bhaal, Slayer within 2d6 miles of where the ravager form fell.

traits.name: Cull the Weak
traits.descriptionHtml: When the ravager damages a creature with a melee attack and the target is left with 20 or fewer remaining hit points, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.descriptionHtml: The ravager is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If the ravager fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The ravager has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.descriptionHtml: The ravager's Claw, Bite, and Spines attacks are magical.

traits.name: Spiked Hide
traits.descriptionHtml: At the start of each of its turns, the ravager deals 16 (3d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it or being grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The ravager makes one Bite attack and then either two Claw attacks or two Spines attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Large or smaller creatures damaged by this attack are grappled (escape DC 20) and the ravager can't make another Bite attack until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Spines
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +14 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. {@h}17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Detect
entries.descriptionHtml: The ravager makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Spiky Carapace
entries.descriptionHtml: The ravager flares its numerous spines and they elongate. Any creature within 5 feet of the ravager must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Smash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The ravager smashes downwards with great force, causing a violent implosion. Any creature within 10 feet of the ravager must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also pulled 5 feet towards the ravager. The noise produced by this attack can be heard up to 1 mile away.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.descriptionHtml: During its first turn, the slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede the slayer's darkvision.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.descriptionHtml: The slayer is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, except for its Ravager Form ability.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If the slayer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.descriptionHtml: The slayer's claw attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The slayer makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

bonusActions.name: Prey
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The slayer focuses on a single creature it can see within 60 feet. Afterwards, the first time each turn that the slayer hits that creature, the slayer does an additional 7 (2d6) damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Savage Disengage
entries.descriptionHtml: The slayer disengages without provoking opportunity attacks. If it moves within 5 feet of a creature it makes a Claw attack against the creature.

entries.name: Finish (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The slayer attacks a creature that has been marked by its Prey ability. If this attack hits and the creature has less than 40 hit points remaining after the attack, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points.

entries.name: Ravager Form (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: If the slayer has killed a creature of CR/level 5 or greater that it previously marked with its Prey ability in the last minute, it can transform into its Bhaal, Ravager. The form lasts until dawn (minimum 1 hour).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Bodhi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: Bodhi regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.descriptionHtml: If Bodhi is destroyed, her body immediately appears in her resting place. She is paralyzed until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 24 hours in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this manner, if a creature within 60 feet says her name 9 times, Bodhi is permanently destroyed.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.descriptionHtml: Bodhi deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Bodhi that isn't incapacitated and Bodhi doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.descriptionHtml: Bodhi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Summoned By Name (1/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If a creature says Bodhi Irenicus's full name 9 times in a row, Bodhi hears her name and becomes aware of the creature. Bodhi knows the exact location and name of the creature that spoke her name. She can then choose, as a free action, to teleport to a location adjacent to the creature. She must choose to do this within 1 minute of hearing her name. This power works even if the creature is on a different plane of existence. 1 minute after teleporting, Bodhi teleports back to where she was located when she heard her name spoken. This occurs even if Bodhi is unwilling and even if she is in an antimagic effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.descriptionHtml: Bodhi Irenicus has the following flaws:

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Bodhi makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, one of which can be a Bite attack instead.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Bodhi can grapple a Medium-sized or smaller target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Vampire Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Bodhi regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Bodhi's control.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.descriptionHtml: If Bodhi isn't in sunlight, she can polymorph into a Medium panther or back into her true form. While in panther form, Bodhi Irenicus can't speak, her walking speed is 40 feet, and she has a climb speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Charm
actions.descriptionHtml: Bodhi targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Bodhi, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Bodhi. The charmed target regards Bodhi as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Bodhi's control, it takes Bodhi's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Bodhi or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Bodhi is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Move
entries.descriptionHtml: Bodhi moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.descriptionHtml: Bodhi makes one Unarmed Strike.

entries.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Bodhi makes one Bite attack.

2e.name: Nondetection
2e.components: V, S, M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)

traits.name: Bolts of Undead Slaying
traits.descriptionHtml: Borivik has a half-dozen bolts of undead slaying. If he strikes an Undead creature with one of these magic bolts, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Borivik makes two Shortsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Crossbow Expert
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Borivik adds 1d10 to his next attack or damage roll with his Heavy Crossbow attack.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Borivik can take the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Enduring Response
reactions.descriptionHtml: When Borivik takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, he gains immunity to that damage type until the start of his next turn. Also, the first time he hits with a Shortsword attack on his next turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) of the triggering damage type.

atWill.name: Wall of Ice
atWill.components: V, S, M (a piece of quartz)

2e.name: Cone of Cold
2e.components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)

2e.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
2e.components: V, S, M (a miniature crystal sphere)

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.descriptionHtml: At the start of each of Cryonax's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) cold damage. A creature also takes 21 (6d6) cold damage if they touch or hit Cryonax. Nonmagical weapons that hit Cryonax are frozen immediately after dealing damage to Cryonax. If used again and they hit any creature, the weapon shatters. The freezing effect disappears after an hour.

traits.name: Empowered Attacks
traits.descriptionHtml: Cryonax's Slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical weapons.

traits.name: Ice Walker
traits.descriptionHtml: No ability checks are required when Cryonax walks or climbs across icy surfaces and difficult snow or ice terrain does not cost him extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Cryonax fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Cryonax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Cryonax makes two Slam attacks with his tentacles or two Ice Spear attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Cryonax can grapple up to two targets but any tentacle that is grappling can't be used to make a Slam or Ice Spear attack.

actions.name: Ice Spear
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}36 (6d10 + 3) cold damage.

actions.name: Summon Frost Horde (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Cryonax summons two young white dragon or a frost giant with two yeti. The summoning costs Cryonax 50 hit points. The summoned creatures have maximum hit points and appear within 100 feet of Cryonax.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Smash
entries.descriptionHtml: Cryonax slams a grappled target against the ground, dealing 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage to it.

entries.name: Tentacle Freeze
entries.descriptionHtml: Cryonax's tentacle freezes a grappled target. If the target fails a DC 22 Constitution saving throw they are paralyzed and Cryonax releases them from its tentacle. They remain frozen indefinitely but can attempt the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns. Success means they are no longer frozen.

entries.name: Ice Shroud (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: With a gesture Cryonax targets a frozen creature (see Tentacle Freeze) that is within 30 feet of him. The target is encased instantly in a hard shell of crushing ice. The target receives no saving throw and takes 22 (5d8) cold damage immediately and at the start of each of their turns. The target is considered stunned but is partly protected by the shroud and resistant to all damage. The shroud disappears if Cryonax removes it, Cryonax dies, the shroud takes 100 hit points of damage or another character uses their action and succeeds on a DC 22 Strength check to remove the trapped ally.

2e.name: Hold Monster

traits.name: Draconic Transformation
traits.descriptionHtml: When Dagryn drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, he transforms into his dragon form. He immediately gains all the statistics of an adult black dragon with the exception that his size is Medium, and has the stunned condition. At the start of his next turn, he grows to Large size, but remains stunned. At the start of his subsequent turn, Dagryn grows to Huge size and is no longer stunned. Dagryn remains in his dragon form for 24 hours whereupon he reverts to this stat block.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.descriptionHtml: Dagryn has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

actions.name: Club
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eruption
actions.descriptionHtml: rs +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage.

bonusActions.name: Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Dagryn magically turns invisible for 1 hour or until he attacks or casts a spell. Any equipment Dagryn wears or carries turns invisible with him.

atWill.name: False Life
atWill.components: V, S, M (a drop of alcohol)

atWill.name: Invisibility

While transformed, he gains 50 temporary hit points, proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throw, adds his Multiattack feature, and loses his Draining Counterspell reaction and Spellcasting action.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.descriptionHtml: Kagain wields a +3 greataxe. While Kagain is attuned to this weapon, his hit point maximum increases to 178. Whenever a hostile creature damages Kagain while the axe is in his possession, he must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. He can choose to fail this saving throw. While berserk, Kagain gains advantage on all melee attacks and attacks made against him are made with advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Kagain makes three attacks with his Berserking Greataxe.

actions.descriptionHtml: mw +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (1d12 + 7) slashing damage.

entries.descriptionHtml: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack.

entries.name: Berserk Whirlwind (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack against every creature within 5 feet of him.

atWill.components: V, S, M (a focus worth 100+ GP, either a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing)

atWill.name: Invisibility
atWill.components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)

atWill.name: Spider Climb
atWill.components: V, S, M (a drop of bitumen and a spider)

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede the kelubar's darkvision.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.descriptionHtml: The kelubar is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical affects don't reduce its speed or cause it to be paralyzed or restrained. If the kelubar spends 5 feet of movement is automatically escapes from nonmagical restraints or a creature that has it grappled. It is also able to move underwater with no movement or attack penalties.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.descriptionHtml: The kelubar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The kelubar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.descriptionHtml: The kelubar's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.descriptionHtml: At the start of its turn, the kelubar can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.descriptionHtml: The kelubar deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the kelubar that isn't incapacitated and the kelubar doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Stench
traits.descriptionHtml: Any creature that is not a demodand and starts its turn within 30 feet of the kelubar must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of this kelubar for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The kelubar makes one Bite attack and three Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

bonusActions.name: Summon Demodand (1/Day)
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: The kelubar rolls a d6. A result of 1-2 summons in two allied farastu stalker, a result of 3-4 summons in one allied kelubar consul.

reactions.name: Impossible Dodge
reactions.descriptionHtml: When an attacker that the kelubar can see hits it with an attack, the kelubar can use its reaction to halve the attack's damage.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.descriptionHtml: Kivan has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Kivan to sleep.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Kivan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Kivan makes three Longsword attacks or three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +7 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley (2/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Kivan makes a Longbow attack against any number of creatures he can see within 150 feet. He must make a separate attack roll with advantage for each target.

bonusActions.name: Kivan's Mark
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Kivan designates one creature he can see within 60 feet as his prey. The first time each turn that Kivan hits his prey with a weapon attack, the prey takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the weapon.

1e.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)

1e.name: Plane Shift
1e.components: V, S, M (a forked, metal rod worth 250+ GP and attuned to a plane of existence)

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.descriptionHtml: Lothar can mimic simple sounds he has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: Lothar makes three Greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, 14 (1d12 + 8) while in a rage.

actions.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 piercing damage in raven form, or 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage in hybrid form. If the target is Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wereraven Player Characters as Lycanthropes.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.descriptionHtml: Lothar can use his action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid, or into a Small raven, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Lothar reverts to his true form if he dies.

bonusActions.name: Rage
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Lothar rages for 1 minute. During his rage he has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. He gains a +4 bonus to damage while he is in a rage. He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage while in a rage. Lothar can't cast spells while in a rage.

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: Magical darkness doesn't impede Mephistopheles' darkvision.

traits.name: Fiendish Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Mephistopheles only dies if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when he flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Hellfire Mastery
traits.descriptionHtml: Fire damage that Mephistopheles inflicts ignores resistances and immunities. Mephistopheles is immune to this effect.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Mephistopheles fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles makes three Ranseur attacks. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellfire Lash (if available).

actions.name: Ranseur, +3
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 18 (4d8) fire or cold damage (Mephistopheles' choice).

actions.name: Hellfire Implosion (Recharge 4)
actions.descriptionHtml: A bright streak of Hellfire appears at a point that Mephistopheles can see within 150 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 31 (9d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Hellfire Lash (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles unleashes a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide lash of Hellfire that ignites a 5-foot-radius sphere around where it strikes. Any targets in the area of effect must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Ashen Teleport
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles' body and any equipment he is wearing or carrying turns to ash, then he magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and reforms.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Hellfire Wings
entries.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles uses his wings to generate a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of him must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. Creatures that failed the save also have the prone condition.

entries.name: Hellfire Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles creates a rain of Hellfire at a point he can see within 150 feet. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 38 (7d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Mephistopheles summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

traits.name: Boo, The Miniature Giant Space Hamster
traits.descriptionHtml: Boo is Minsc's animal companion. Boo is a miniature giant space hamster and has the statistics of a rat.

traits.name: Favored Enemy
traits.descriptionHtml: Minsc's favored enemy is evil. When he hits an evil creature with a melee attack he deals an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.descriptionHtml: At the start of his turn, Minsc may choose to gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Minsc makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Go for the Eyes, Boo
bonusActions.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, Minsc talks to Boo and gains the inspiration to go into a berserker fury, for 1 minute. While in this berserking fury Minsc gains the following:

  • Minsc has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
  • Minsc gains a +4 bonus to damage rolls when using a melee weapon.
  • Minsc has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
  • Minsc can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of his turns.
  • Minsc can't be charmed or frightened. If Minsc is charmed or frightened when he enters his berserking fury, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage
  • If Minsc drops to 0 hit points and doesn't die outright, he can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If he succeeds, he drops to 1 hit point instead. Each time he uses this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. After 24 hours, the DC resets to 10.

reactions.name: Run, Boo, Run
reactions.descriptionHtml: If Boo takes damage, Minsc can choose to take the damage instead.

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.descriptionHtml: During his first turn, Montaron has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Montaron scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.descriptionHtml: If Montaron is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Montaron instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Nimbleness
traits.descriptionHtml: Montaron can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.descriptionHtml: Montaron deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Montaron that isn't incapacitated and Montaron doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.descriptionHtml: Montaron possesses a bag of holding. He keeps the demilich, Xzar, in the bag. He also possesses a portable hole, which he uses to aid in robberies. As a bonus action, Montaron can place his portable hole in his bag of holding. This instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Montaron and any creature within 10 feet of him is sucked through the gate to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Montaron makes three Shortsword attacks and uses the ability Unleash the Demilich if available.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unleash the Demilich (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Montaron reaches inside his bag of holding and releases Xzar. Xzar is a demilich and appears within 5 feet of Montaron. Xzar rolls for his own initiative. Xzar can't use lair actions or legendary actions. He has a CR of 14.

atWill.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)

atWill.name: Sanctuary

actions.name: Mace
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Corona of Beauty
actions.descriptionHtml: Naes activates an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until he dismisses it using an action. He emits bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. His enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune (Recharge 4)
actions.descriptionHtml: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have Cover must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

reactions.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
reactions.descriptionHtml: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

traits.name: Potion Mishap
traits.descriptionHtml:
When Nauk uses the Imbibe Potion action more than once in an hour, roll 1d4 for what happens:

  • 1. The potion works normally.
  • 2. The potion works normally. In addition, Nauk turns invisible for 1 minute or until Nauk attacks or casts a spell.
  • 3. The potion has no effect.
  • 4. Instead of the normal effect, the potion causes fire to explode out of Nauk's mouth in a 15 foot cone. Nauk and any creature in the cone take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Relentless
traits.descriptionHtml: When Nauk is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can drop to 1 hit point instead. He can't use this feature again for 24 hours

traits.name: Special Items
traits.descriptionHtml: Nauk wears adamantine plate armor. He wields a +1 maul and a +1 heavy crossbow which is already factored into his stats. He has 2 potion of cold resistance, 2 potion of fire resistance, 2 potion of lightning resistance. He has 2 potion of heroism and 4 potion of superior healing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Nauk makes three Magic Maul attacks. Nauk may substitute one of those attacks for the Imbibe Potion action.

actions.name: Magic Maul
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +6 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Imbibe Potion
actions.descriptionHtml:
Nauk drinks a potion from the following list:

  • Potion of heroism: Nauk gains 10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. For the same duration, Nauk is under the effect of the bless spell (no concentration required).
  • Potion of resistance: Nauk gains resistance from one damage type for 1 hour. Nauk chooses from one of these damage types: cold, fire, lightning.
  • Potion of superior healing: Nauk regains 28 hit points.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.descriptionHtml: Nauk adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Nauk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5)

bonusActions.name: Dispel
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Pazuzu casts dispel magic, automatically dispelling any spell of 6th level or lower on the target.

bonusActions.name: Hasted Greatsword
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Pazuzu uses his magic greatsword to grant him the following abilities until the start of his next turn. Pazuzu's speed is now doubled, he gains a +2 bonus to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and gains one additional Greatsword attack.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Disarm
entries.descriptionHtml: Pazuzu attempts to knock a weapon out of a target's hand. He makes a Greatsword attack and if it hits, the target does not take damage but instead must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. If the target fails the saving throw, the targeted weapon flies 10 feet away in a random direction.

entries.name: Lethal Leap
entries.descriptionHtml: Pazuzu attacks once with his Greatsword or Talon and then may fly up to 60 feet away. Pazuzu's movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)

actions.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Pelyious can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.descriptionHtml: Pelyious polymorphs into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

bonusActions.name: Slippery Step (2/Day)

traits.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm discerns the location of all magical auras within sight and knows which creatures within 60 feet are spellcasters.

traits.name: Extended Concentration
traits.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm can concentrate on two different spells at the same time. If concentration is broken, then both spells fade immediately.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm makes four Claw attacks and then makes a Bite or Stinger attack. Alternatively, it uses Spellcasting and then makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, they have the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The phaerimm's poison forces the paralyzed target to float 5 feet above the ground. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of it's turns.

actions.name: Implant
actions.descriptionHtml: The phaerimm makes a Stinger attack against a paralyzed target. If the stinger hits, an egg is implanted in the target. This egg can only be removed by spells that cure disease, such as lesser restoration. If the egg is not removed within 90 days, the larva emerges, and the host is killed. A phaerimm has a single egg so may only use this ability once.

actions.descriptionHtml: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Lethargic Song (Humanoid form only)
actions.descriptionHtml: The wolfwere plays a magical melody on an instrument. Every Humanoid within 200 feet of the wolfwere that hears the melody must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be slowed for 10 minutes, as if the slow spell has been cast on them. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. A target that successfully saves is immune to this wolfwere's melody for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.descriptionHtml: The wolfwere polymorphs into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a Humanoid (elf or human), or back into its true form, which is a dire wolf. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Chaos Phage
traits.descriptionHtml:
Xzar's infusion with the Chaos Phage gives him the following benefits:

  • Xzar regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point
  • Xzar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects
  • Xzar has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder
  • Xzar has darkvision and telepathy to 60 feet

traits.name: Grim Harvest (1/Turn)
traits.descriptionHtml: When Xzar kills a creature that is neither a Construct nor Undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, Xzar regains hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times if it is a necromancy spell.

traits.name: No Soul
traits.descriptionHtml: Since Xzar doesn't have a soul, resurrection magic is able to work upon him no matter how much time has passed. For example, the revivify spell would work on Xzar even a week after he died. However, spells like true resurrection and wish are unable to bring Xzar back to life if no body exists.

actions.name: Death Eruption (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: Negative energy erupts from Xzar, intensified by the Chaos Phage. Any creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere around Xzar (but not including Xzar) must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 36 (8d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this ability rises at the start of Xzar's next turn as a zombie under his command.
